articles.title: Honda collaborates with Nate Smith for Long Live Country Rock & Roll Tour
articles.mainIdea: Honda collaborates with Nate Smith for Long Live Country Rock & Roll Tour
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Honda collaborates with Nate Smith for Long Live Country Rock & Roll Tour. American Honda and chart-topping country artist Nate Smith kicked off an exciting collaboration this past weekend during the first three stops of Smith's Long Live Country Rock & Roll Tour, Powered by Honda. Honda is serving as the presenting sponsor for the tour, which launched March 26 at Cain's Ballroom in Tulsa with opener Brandon Wisham. In addition, special guests Josh Ross and Just Jayne will appear on select dates.
